title: Operators commuting with $L^\infty$]{Operators commuting with $L^\infty$ on Köthe--Bochner spaces
summary: Let $E(X)$ be a Köthe--Bochner space of functions on a $σ$-finite measure space with values in a Banach space $X$. We study bounded operators on $E(X)$ that commute with the operators of multiplication by functions from $L^\infty$. If $X$ is separable, every such operator acts pointwise by an essentially bounded $L(X)$-valued function. For a nonseparable $X$, a lifting of $L^\infty$ provides a representation by $L(X,X^{\star\star})$-valued functions, and by $L(X)$-valued functions if $X$ is complemented in $X^{\star\star}$, with the sharp norm bound if $X$ is a dual space.
